title: Kid Rena's tone and why he never left New Orleans
summary: Watts remembers second lining behind Kid Rena, praises his sweet tone and says he stayed in the corner bars rather than join Armstrong in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

Now, he's another one like, you know, you know, like them old time musicians. They drank that stuff. They fought it too much, man. He'd have let it ruin the career.
